old:
GameEngine never enables Tailscale Funnel. It may query `tailscale funnel status
--json` read-only so it can refuse to touch a port already associated with public
exposure. If port 443 already has a Serve/Funnel configuration that GameEngine
cannot prove it owns, setup reports a conflict and leaves that configuration
unchanged. It never uses a global Serve reset/delete as a shortcut.
new:
GameEngine never enables Tailscale Funnel and does not invoke the `tailscale
funnel` subcommand at all. It reads the Funnel-allowance flags carried by
`tailscale serve status --json` so it can refuse to touch a port already
associated with public exposure. If port 443 already has a Serve/Funnel
configuration that GameEngine cannot prove it owns, setup reports a conflict and
leaves that configuration unchanged. It never uses a global Serve reset/delete
as a shortcut.
